author: reek
body: Paper RPG abstraction. A game system that any clan can customize with their own stats, classes, races, skills, and combat rules. Originally Magic was a short thing between D&D sessions - now the D&D sits inside the same platform, and a card game can spawn an RPG session which can spawn a chess match. Turtles all the way.

author: reek
body: The RPG engine is generic: a game master defines the system, the players make characters, the GM narrates. Combat, skill checks, and loot are all resolved by the engine. Items won in dungeons are real tokens on the economy - tradeable, sellable, usable across games.
